own_solution.law: P = m g h / t at constant speed
assumptions: losses in the lifting gear not counted

defect_reasons.other: With a box strapped onto the load (T920A, T8A2F), 'power the motor delivers to the load' admits a reading as power to the 80 kg load alone (470.4 W) rather than to the lifted assembly (540.96 W); the certified reading is the more natural one, helped by 'the mass given is that of the load alone', so this is wording only.

notes: Checked R answers: (80+7)*9.8*6/10 = 511.56 W, 92*5.88 = 540.96 W, 108*5.88 = 635.04 W. C cancellation m g((q+h) - q)/t is correct for all starting heights. Minimal pairs TAAAC/T8A2F (crate vs load) and TBE39/T920A (earlier lift only vs before this lift) keep 12 kg and differ only in attachment; T3979 and T4034 are declared numeral-free controls. Pass-1 medium wording flag retained; no high defect.
